prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1367; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I observed two vehicles with heavy front-end and right-side damage resting in the eastbound lanes. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the vehicle was turning left at the intersection when the front of the vehicle was struck by a southbound pickup operated by Driver 2. Driver 2 stated that he did not see the sedan until impact and was attempting to stop. A Passenger riding in the front seat of Driver 1's vehicle was also present at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and said symptoms began shortly after the collision. Driver 1 was transported by EMS for evaluation and was alert and oriented at the scene. Both vehicles were towed. Traffic signal timing and witness statements were reviewed, and no citations were issued at the time of this report pending further investigation.
